profile.name: Muhammad Mahatir
profile.shortBio: I engineer digital experiences that are functional, scalable and human-centered. Specialized in Full-Stack Web & SaaS architecture.
profile.bio: I’m a software engineer who loves turning complex problems into simple, digital tools. My journey started back in 2016 building desktop apps for accounting and government reporting, which eventually led me to the web. During my time at Ejen2u, I specialized in the SaaS multi-tenant architecture—an expertise I’ve since poured into my own projects like wishwash.id and Edeskel. Whether it's helping villages go digital or streamlining hospital management, I’m most at home when I’m bridging the gap between technology and real-world impact.

projects.title: WISHWASH.ID
projects.shortDesc: Multi-outlet laundry POS platform that makes order tracking effortless.
projects.desc: A robust multi-tenant SaaS Point of Sale (POS) specifically built for laundry businesses. It streamlines operations with real-time order tracking, automated customer notifications, and comprehensive financial reporting. The system uses a highly scalable database architecture to handle multiple business branches seamlessly within a single integrated platform.

projects.title: EDESKEL.ID
projects.shortDesc: Digital village governance app automating administration and citizen data.
projects.desc: A dedicated multi-tenant SaaS platform designed to digitize village administration and correspondence. It empowers local governments by automating document generation, managing population data, and providing a centralized hub for village reports. Built to bridge the digital divide, it ensures secure and efficient data management for rural communities.

projects.title: CRM SYSTEM
projects.shortDesc: Analytics dashboard for sales pipelines, data visualization and AI reporting.
projects.desc: A production-deployed Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform designed to streamline client workflows, sales tracking, and operational automation.

projects.title: F8 MAKASSAR.COM
